note: How much ecology per climate tick can be given up, and what it costs. This is the deterministic lever on the clock: fewer plant steps per simulated second is less work per second, in the same proportion, and it is a parameter baked into the link rather than a property of the machine. plants-measured.md records 12 through 32 as inside the noise across a 2.7x range of climate exposure; 6 and 8 are below anything measured. Ticks count ECOLOGY steps, so every arm is compared at equal generations rather than equal weather.
